test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If a : b :: b : c; c = 25a and b = 20, find the positive value of c
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **a : b :: b : c** ⇒ **b² = ac**.

Substitute **c = 25a** and **b = 20**.

(20)² = a × 25a ⇒ 400 = 25a².

a² = 16 ⇒ a = 4.

c = 25 × 4 = 100.

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/128568c582257f757ffe5978b2dd25ab9e0afeba5d0d6c73d638dcda1d10ead6.png] 

**Given:** b = 20, c = 25a

**Formula Used:** In a continued proportion a : b :: b : c, b² = ac

⇒ b² = a × c

⇒ (20)² = a × (25a)

⇒ 400 = 25a²

⇒ a² = 400 ÷ 25

⇒ a² = 16

⇒ a = √16 = 4

⇒ c = 25a = 25 × 4

⇒ c = 100

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

In the proportion a : b :: b : c, **b** is called the **mean proportional** between a and c, where b = √ac.

Third Proportional

In the proportion a : b :: b : c, **c** is called the **third proportional** to a and b, where c = b²/a.

Fourth Proportional

If four quantities a, b, c, d are in proportion (a : b :: c : d), then **d** is the **fourth proportional**, where d = (b × c) / a.</p
